images.prompt: Low-angle wide shot of an industrial mining vessel with upward-facing guns hovering in a ring of crystalline asteroids around a huge violet planet.
Close action shot of an asteroid bursting apart under an energy blast, crystal shards, sand-like grains and vapor clouds spraying outward.
Overhead view of a network of space stations and outposts joined by glowing teal trade routes around a central hub.

Portrait cover, solid flat-shaded low-poly 3D render. At the bottom of the frame, a wide flat rectangular grey mining ship shaped like a long hovering slab, seen from below and slightly in front, with a blaster cannon at each end pointing straight up and two big glowing thrusters on its underside. Teal laser bolts fly upward from its cannons into a glittering band of violet crystalline asteroids filling the middle of the frame, crumbling into streams of sand-like grains that fall back toward the ship. Above it all, a huge alien gas giant with swirling violet and lilac storm bands and a ring arcing across the starry sky.
Wide view of a planetary ring threaded with industrial stations and glowing gateways around a bright swirling disk, ringed planets in the starry sky.
